title: Linear customer quotes
description: Two tall quote cards side by side in a faint rounded frame: a wide one in a pale blue-to-lavender glow and a narrow one in electric lime, each with a large hanging-quote line at the top and the speaker, role and company at the bottom behind a thin divider. A grey line with a bold figure and a 'Customer stories →' link sit underneath. The row comes into focus out of a blur as it scrolls into view; cards brighten slightly on hover. On phones the cards swipe sideways.
notes: two quotes read best (wide + narrow); more add further narrow cards
card colours: glow → chart-5 gradient and highlight, with highlight-foreground text; works on any theme where those are light
the blur-in is a CSS scroll-driven animation; browsers without it, and reduced motion, show the cards in focus
